answers.rationale: The requirement specifies integrated power and cooling infrastructure for an AI training campus. ANORD-POD provides prefabricated modular power pods, which align with the modular deployment preference. JETCOOL-CDU offers coolant distribution units for liquid cooling, meeting the cooling needs.
This requirement specifies the IT capacity of the campus. It is a design parameter rather than a product requirement, so no specific product is mapped.
The redundancy requirement at the rack level (N+1) can be met by FPM-SHELF, which provides rack power shelves with N+1 power supply redundancy.
The preference for 800VDC rack-level distribution can be addressed by FPM-SHELF, which supports higher-voltage architectures suitable for this requirement.
The requirement for 120kW rack density and liquid cooling at rack and chip level can be met by JETCOOL-PLATE for direct-to-chip cooling and JETCOOL-CDU for rack-level liquid cooling.
This requirement describes the site location and grid interconnect status, which are contextual details rather than product requirements.
Compliance requirements such as UL, IEC 61439, and NEC Article 645 are standards to be adhered to during design and manufacturing, not specific product requirements.
The preference for prefabricated/modular systems aligns with ANORD-POD, which provides prefabricated modular power pods for fast deployment.
The scope includes grid interface through rack-level power and cooling. ANORD-POD can provide modular power solutions, and JETCOOL-CDU can handle the cooling requirements.
